g.text: All connections are by net label. GPIO8/GPIO9 are strapping pins:

g.desc: All connections are by net label. GPIO8/GPIO9 are strapping pins:

g.text: the GY-271 pull-ups hold them high, which is the normal-boot state.

g.desc: the GY-271 pull-ups hold them high, which is the normal-boot state.

g.text: POWER: solar -> TP4056 (charger + DW01A/FS8205A protection) -> SW1 -> ESP32-C3 5V pin

g.desc: POWER: solar -> TP4056 (charger + DW01A/FS8205A protection) -> SW1 -> ESP32-C3 5V pin

g.text: BATTERY SENSE: 1:2 divider (100k/100k, ~21uA) after SW1. 4.2V -> 2.1V on GPIO0 / ADC1_CH0

g.desc: BATTERY SENSE: 1:2 divider (100k/100k, ~21uA) after SW1. 4.2V -> 2.1V on GPIO0 / ADC1_CH0

g.text: U2 REWORK: replace the module R_PROG (1.2k, marked 122, on TP4056 pin 2) with 3.0k

g.desc: U2 REWORK: replace the module R_PROG (1.2k, marked 122, on TP4056 pin 2) with 3.0k

g.text: -> 400 mA charge = 0.9C for the 450 mAh cell (stock 1 A = 2.2C).

g.desc: -> 400 mA charge = 0.9C for the 450 mAh cell (stock 1 A = 2.2C).

g.text: USB on the SuperMini back-feeds the battery: switch SW1 OFF before plugging in USB.
